technical.summary: Early-stage momentum signals (stochrsi cross, MACD crossover) show bullish intent but lack confirmation from trend structure; price remains below 50-day moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 22 days create a weak fundamental setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (29/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is neutral with only small trades 89-94 days ago and no senior conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (319), and earnings binary event in 22 days create compounded downside risk for discretionary consumer stock.

debate.key_bull_argument: Early momentum crossovers (StochRSI, MACD) combined with supertrend bullish signal and extreme fear sentiment (29/100) create a contrarian entry opportunity near support at 247.43.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below both 50-day moving averages and Ichimoku cloud with weak trend confirmation (ADX), compounded by severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis), earnings binary in 22 days, and below-average volume—creating asymmetric downside risk for a discretionary consumer stock.

decision.entry_rationale: Early momentum crossovers (StochRSI, MACD) and contrarian fear sentiment (29/100) offer tactical appeal, but price remains structurally below 50-day MAs and Ichimoku cloud with weak trend confirmation.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 22 days combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and discretionary sector cyclicality create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs early momentum signals.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
